_note: 2_08 'Weed Killer' — disguised as a preppy, Jimmy talks his way past Bif into Harrington House, steals the pesticide sprayer on the third floor, kills the giant weed plant in the solarium, and fights back out (recon: docs/re-notes/ch2/2_08-weed-killer.md). The recon's structural surprise — the mission is split between 2_08.lua and the always-on area script PrepHouse.lua talking through shared.* globals — is compressed away: our missions are self-contained (area_script_shared_state recorded as pending). v1 simplifications (see the recon's gap table): the disguise checklist (24 hair-model families + Aquaberry torso + no-hat outfit predicates) collapses to two purchase beats (salon + dorm clothing manager — the money_ensure $12 floor from the original's setup makes the broke fail moot); the disguise has no mechanical effect (no conditional_faction_attitude — the preps-like-you thread is skipped); the Bif gate takes the friendly path only (a greet social; the beat-Bif path, the 40%-health scripting and the door choreography are compressed — the foyer is open geometry for us); each floor's two-ped conversation-then-provoked guard pair is a hostile-on-sight wave (the breakable-noise alerts need the ~30-prop registry — pending); the pesticide pickup is a reach+item beat (weapon 395 INFERRED there); the flytrap is a stationary boss_bar target dummy (prop_health_bar/prop_destroy_threshold_event pending — no drivable destructible props, same posture as 2_S02); the solarium ambush micro-scene, the stairs-door choreography and the 'one more guy' door gag compress to one exit wave (second-floor ambusher + Bif rematch); the door-action exit-to-win is a reach beat outside. Wording is original; ped_model_id records the original model ids next to the stand-in meshes. Pass pays $30 via the campaign on_pass (banner param 3000, INFERRED cents).
title: Weed Killer

lines.speaker: JIMMY
lines.text: A giant weed in the preps' greenhouse, and I'm the exterminator. First rule of pest control: look like the client. Time for a haircut.

stages.objective: Get a fancy haircut at the salon.

on_complete.speaker: BARBER
on_complete.text: The Ivy League special. Very... Old Money.

stages.objective: Get the Aquaberry sweater from the dorm wardrobe.

on_complete.speaker: JIMMY
on_complete.text: Sweater, hair, no hat. Practically a Harrington already.

stages.objective: Talk your way into Harrington House.

on_complete.speaker: BIF
on_complete.text: Evening, old chap. Mind the floors.

stages.objective: Third floor — the sprayer is close.

on_complete.speaker: JIMMY
on_complete.text: Industrial pesticide. That plant is going down.

on_complete.speaker: JIMMY
on_complete.text: Timber. Oops — I mean, weed's dead.

stages.objective: The whole house knows. Fight your way down.

on_start.speaker: BIF
on_start.text: You! You were never one of us — get him!
